title: Pocketwire Rewards Offers Bulletin: Boost Activity Lift on Gift Card Redemptions
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members who earned boost points over the last twelve months receive a boost lift on the rate at which their points are valued for a gift card.

## Rule

The gift card boost lift is 0.05 cents per point when the ledger carries at least 4 boost entries dated within the last twelve months, 0.02 cents per point when it carries at least 1 but fewer than 4, and nothing when it carries none; boost activations that never earned are not counted.

The lift is added to the gift card rate per point before the rate is applied to the points redeemed.

A boost entry is the entry that credits boost points on a boosted card purchase. A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Count and lift

| Boost entries within the last twelve months | Lift (cents per point) |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 0.05 |
| 1, 2 or 3 | 0.02 |
| none | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- Five boost activations, of which three earned boost points: three boost entries, 0.02 cents per point.
- Four boost entries, the oldest dated on the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date: that entry is outside the window, leaving three, 0.02 cents per point.
